column1: # NanoEls H4 CNC fork: 16 MB flash (ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R2). nvs stays where the default layout has it
# so the H4 settings and stored programs survive. Two 3 MB firmware slots (update over WiFi) and
# 9.9 MB for G-code files (LittleFS). In the Arduino IDE choose Flash Size: 16MB (128Mb).
